text:
Maria: kicking off the account/project + VPC wiring for the new london-gpu region. goal: bootstrap one project with networking, enable GPU quotas, and handoff to cluster team by EOD Friday. checklist attached below, pinging @James and @Lin for quota/iam items :smile:

James: ack. I can take quotas + service control policies. which cloud is this for? aws or gcp?

Maria: AWS (eu-west-2 equivalent). we'll use the standard account template, but need a special subnet layout for GPU hosts (larger /20 pools) and dedicated mgmt subnets for bastion + monitoring.

Lin: FYI we need to request EC2 Elastic Inference and GPU instance quotas (p4d, p4de, g5) — I'll open the service-quotas ticket. also enable ENA support and udp fragment size tweaks (we had perf issues last time).

Ricardo: sounds good. for VPC design, recommend: 3 AZs, 2 private subnets per AZ (gpu, services), 1 public mgmt subnet per AZ. Transit Gateway peering to prod-VPC with restricted routes (only internal control plane CIDRs).

Maria: here's the minimal terraform snippet we're using in the account module (for review):

```
module \"vpc\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@repo/redwood-terraform//modules/aws/vpc\"
  name   = \"redwood-london-gpu\"
  cidr   = \"10.40.0.0/16\"
  azs    = [\"eu-west-2a\",\"eu-west-2b\",\"eu-west-2c\"]
  private_subnet_ranges = [\"10.40.0.0/19\",\"10.40.32.0/19\",\"10.40.64.0/19\"]
  tags = {
    Team = \"infra\"
    Project = \"gpu-clusters\"
  }
}
```

James: quick checklist items from my side:
- open service-quotas requests (gpu families) -> request numbers in ticket 12345
- enable IAM permission boundaries for account admins
- create billing alarm + notify #finance-alerts

Lin: infra-bot created quota ticket: https://support.aws.amazon.com/quotas/ticket/98765 :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform plan for module 'vpc' completed in ~12s. PR: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pull/482

Ricardo: validation steps before handoff:
1) VPC and subnets created and tagged correctly.
2) Route tables: ensure NAT gateways in each AZ for private egress.
3) Security groups: ephemeral port policy for inter-node (7400-7600), SSH restricted to jump hosts only.
4) Transit Gateway routes limited to 10.40.0.0/16 and control-plane 10.10.0.0/24.
5) Quota confirmation from AWS support for target instance types.
6) A smoke cluster deployed with 2 GPU nodes and run the benchmark job (smoke-runner.sh).

Maria: adding cost checkpoint: estimate monthly baseline if we run 8x A100-ish GPUs reserved for tests: ~ $24k/month (on-demand). propose to start with burst-only (no reserved) and enable cost alarms at $6k/week.

James: suggest creating a quota-ohai alert in ops for sudden spike in instance counts. also add tagging enforcement for cost-center tags via SCP.

Lin: test commands for quota validation: 
- aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A  # example
- aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings --location-type availability-zone --filters Name=instance-type,Values=p4d*

Maria: can someone run the smoke cluster deploy once TF is applied? steps are in the PR description. also need a quick network perf check (iperf3) between cluster nodes and control plane.

Ricardo: I'll run the smoke deploy after TF apply, then ping back with a short report: network RTT, packet loss, and kernel dmesg for ENA messages.

James: IAM handoff items: create service accounts for cluster autoscaler, nodepool manager, and monitoring with least-privilege roles. PR created: https://git.company/redwood/infra/pull/485

Maria: timeline: TF apply by today noon -> quotas approved by EOD -> smoke cluster + perf run by 17:00 -> handoff notes in confluence and tag @eng-runtime. If any quota delays, fallback plan: bring up a smaller cpu-only test cluster and run connectivity checks.

Lin: noted. opening a runbook stub: https://confluence.company/pages/newregion-gpu (will fill in after tests).

infra-bot: reminder: cost-alert created (threshold $6000 per week) and slack hook added to #eng-infra-alerts.

Maria: great. once Ricardo posts the smoke report we'll close this thread and move to the handoff checklist. thanks all :rocket:

Ricardo: smoke deploy done. results:
- 2x g4dn instances (placeholder until p4 quotas open)
- iperf3: avg 1.2 Gbps between nodes, RTT 0.9ms, no packet loss.
- kernel: ENA v5 OK, no errors.
- observed instance warmup time ~ 140s.

Maria: perfect — I'll update confluence and mark this ready for eng-runtime. moving to handoff. :tada:
